NEW MAPS: - "2026 Public =FoX= Tryouts" by =FoX=Wuzi - "Chiliad's Toughest Trucker" by Mawfeen - "Teetering on the Edge" by Mawfeen - "V8 Baggage" by marshall
UPDATED MAPS: "Bumper Blistas": - - - Inverted flag sizes and added slightly more obvious handholding for the hyperopic amongst us. - - - When a player disconnects, their flag should now be destroyed instead of being left behind. "Coinspiracy Cashout": - - - You will no longer randomly fall through the map when respawning. "Navigation Troubles": - - - Fix typos in navigation announcements. Correct the spelling of "off" and "immediately" in route guidance messages.
GENERAL UPDATES: - Implemented admin command /deletetime2 in all Mawfeen maps with custom leaderboard tracking. - Renamed Pinker-er to vehicle_colorizer and moved rotating chat announcements into a dedicated server_chat_announcements resource. /me message adjustment is now handled in twitch_emotes_core. - Vehicle Customizer: - - Added a new vehicle customisation system submitted by marshall, allowing players to personalise their vehicles across all race maps. - - Press F2 to open the customisation menu and select a vehicle from an alphabetically sorted list. - - Customise individual vehicles with GTA San Andreas tuning parts, including spoilers, bumpers, sideskirts, exhausts, wheels, paintjobs, and custom RGB colours. Nitro and hydraulics are excluded. - - Added a Global Colors & Wheels tab, allowing players to apply their preferred colours and wheel designs to all compatible vehicles without having to customise each model individually. - - Global customisation settings take priority over individual vehicle settings when enabled. - - Vehicle customisation is automatically applied when spawning, respawning, or switching vehicles during races. - - All customisation settings are saved persistently in a server-side SQLite database, so players do not lose their preferences after disconnecting or restarting the game. - - Added a configurable map blacklist, allowing customisation to be disabled on specific maps where it could interfere with intended gameplay. - - Customisation is purely visual and does not modify vehicle handling, performance, or physics. - - Auto pimp is now disabled by default to facilitate the above. - Folf Radio: - - Expanded the radio catalogue with U.S. iHeart stations across genres, including previously non-working 98.3 The KEG (KKEG) and Power 105.7. - - Expanded keys to match their station name and URL. - - Added a GUI for browsing, searching, and playing stations. - - Added paginated /radiolist browsing and made /radio open the station browser GUI when used without a key. - - Added a volume slider (scrollbar) that stays in sync with playback and the /vol command. - - Clarified command usage. - Race AFK Kicker: - - Track eligible AFK time for race players. Count AFK time only while players are ready, unfrozen, active, and watching themselves. Reset warnings and pause tracking when they become ineligible, and document the updated AFK rules. - - Track player activity for AFK kicking. Report keyboard, mouse, and gameplay-control activity to the server, and include time since the last activity in AFK checks. Exclude players who are dead, spectating, not ready, or frozen. - - Refresh AFK timer when settings change. Reload the configured AFK timer and recompute the active timer when an `onSettingChange` event fires.
ACHIEVEMENTS: - Added 3 new Map achievements, for an increase to 283 from 280. - - Maps: - - - "Cone Crazier" ("Expert Van Driver") - - - "Coinspiracy Cashout" ("Numismania") - - - "Rock Hard Truckin'" ("Chiliad's Toughest Trucker") - "Underdog" has been completely reworked and has been reset. - "folffixed" has been moderately reworked and has been reset. - "ReD SS Race" has been added to the list of "Taurus".

GENERAL UPDATES: - The https://mta.joshimuz.com landing page is now configurable from the GitLab repo as well and has been redesigned. - The server's version has been updated to 24153 from 24150. - Death Messages: - - Fix death message colour and vehicle handling. Prevent death messages from crashing when the configured colour is unset by falling back to a default orange. Handle vehicle killers more safely when no player is driving the vehicle, and avoid re-evaluating the bodypart name in a way that could fail. - GPS: - - Fix GPS resource safety checks. Harden the GPS resource against missing nodes, invalid RPC calls, and bad render state. It adds nil checks in node lookup/pathfinding, fixes line-drawing validation and render-target cleanup, and makes coroutine/server callback handling safe when coroutines or callbacks are missing. Avoid crashing on nil table merges. - Hidden Packages Colored: - - Support grouped package resets. Add support for resetting all collected packages by colour code, including the aggregate C shortcut and case-insensitive single-letter filters. This also updates the in-game help text to document the new reset syntax, examples, and usage notes for grouped resets. - Pinker-er: - - Added the /cpBlips command to the random green chat messages. - Player Blips: - - Disable noisy playercolors debug logs. Silence the repeated playercolors startup debug output in the playerblips server script. The log was firing during map editor tests, creating unnecessary noise without adding useful information, so the debug lines are temporarily disabled. - Race: - - Guard scoreboard cleanup on race stop. Prevent the race resource from trying to remove scoreboard columns when the scoreboard resource is not running or not loaded. The cleanup now checks the scoreboard resource state before calling the removal functions, avoiding runtime errors during resource shutdown. - - Added the /cpBlips command to the help (F9) page. - Runcode: - - The HTTP code runner now verifies the authenticated account has command.srun permission before executing Lua, returning a permission denied error and logging unauthorised attempts. This prevents unprivileged users from running code through the HTTP interface. - Security: - - Guard explosion checks for quit players. The admin security script could still log violations for disconnected players because stale entries remained in projectile and explosion tables. This change validates elements before threshold checks and clears player data on onPlayerQuit to prevent false positives and avoid leaving stale state behind. - Spawn Manager: - - Fix spawnpoint validation and team handling. Fix several spawn manager bugs: invalid spawnpoint values now correctly fail validation instead of silently resetting to 0, the `dimension` check was corrected, and `setSpawnpointTeam` stored the team element instead of the skin value. Also fix incorrect getter debug messages, skip queued spawns for invalid/disconnected players, and prevent `getRandomSpawnpoint` from indexing a nil list when no spawnpoints exist. - Speedometer: - - Guard vehicle light overrides. Add an element validity check before calling setVehicleOverrideLights to avoid errors with stale vehicle references.

GENERAL UPDATES: The following changes have been made to the MTA server: - The server's version has been updated to 24150 from 24138. - The main and test MTA servers have been moved and run under dedicated Docker containers to allow isolation from the main system. - - Doing so provides better security and limits attack vectors in case someone finds an exploit to gain RCE on the server. - - Server admins will be able to access server console, files, and a shell inside the container. - - Code and Docker files for MTA companion servers (currently the ghosts server, but in the future could be extended to a toptimes website) have been pushed to the main repo to allow other developers to make changes. - - Server admins will be able to change the MTA server version by simply updating the Dockerfile in the repo. These following changes have been made to facilitate the above changes: - Restructured the GitLab repo. Files have been moved to a subdirectory (`mta/resources`). As a result any current pull requests might hit conflicts that may need to be manually resolved. - A template mta server conf file has been pushed to the repo as well to allow server admins to make changes to autoload/resources directly from GitLab. - Race: - - Added an option to display 3 checkpoint blips on the minimap instead of the default 2. This setting is saved per user and can be adjusted by using the command "/cpblips" followed by either 2 or 3. A third checkpoint blip on the minimap is distinguishable by virtue of it having a lower alpha / transparency value. No further action is required if you prefer only having two checkpoint blips displayed on the minimap, it is still the default. - - Added a setting which server admins can change to adjust the alpha level of the third checkpoint blip on the minimap. The default value is 120. - - Guard GUI visibility for race client. Prevent invalid GUI visibility calls by checking that a GUI handle is actually an element before using guiSetVisible(). This avoids runtime errors when a component is nil or not a GUI element while showing, hiding, or toggling race HUD/UI controls. Fixes a warning when spamming the left or right arrow key when spectating when the map changes. - Race Information UI: - - Guard map folder path concatenation against nil. Fixes building of the displayed map folder path by ensuring both respath and resname exist before concatenating. Replaces expressions like "respath .. '/' .. resname or '<none>'" with a nil-safe conditional that returns the joined path or "<none>". Applied to both corner and big info displays to avoid concatenation errors and incorrect fallbacks when one value is missing. Fixes an error when the race gamemode starts when the map folder display is set to "fullpath" instead of "folder". - Race Voting: - - Added a "voteredo_raceleaderonly" setting which server admins can change. When set to "true", only the current race's leader can start a voteredo until the first person finishes. This is the default case. When set to "false", anyone can start a voteredo at any time for the duration of a map. - - Fixed the Play Again Count not increasing in cases in which it should have done so, for example after a succesful /votemap of the same map or /voteredo. - Twitch Emotes: - - Added 5 new emotes - FBaway, FBfirst, FBhome, joshYeehaw, & SoonerLater2. Also changed the existing SoonerLater emote to an older version. - Vote Manager: - - Added settings which server admins can change to adjust the colour and transparency of the voting poll's background.

GENERAL UPDATES: - Help Manager: - - Updated the resource to the current official version, changing the resources navigation to a list on the left from tabs. - Race Sparkling Anti Social Simulator (SASS): - - Fixed a typographical error in the help (F9) tab title. - Race: - - Guard isVehicleBlown calls with isElement. Ensure g_Vehicle is a valid element before calling isVehicleBlown to avoid runtime errors when g_Vehicle is nil or invalid. The debug log was updated to safely report the vehicle-blown state (false when vehicle is not an element). This prevents crashes in cases like foot races or when the player has no vehicle. - - Guard missing vehicle when saving/restoring state. Add defensive checks for vehicle elements when saving/restoring player state. On the client, savePosition now verifies isElement(g_Vehicle) before reading position/rotation and clears saved vehicle fields if absent; restorePosition only sets vehicle position/rotation when both the element exists and saved data is present. On the server, spectate handling checks g_Vehicles[player] before reading velocities and falls back to zero vectors if the vehicle is missing. Prevents runtime errors when a player's vehicle element is unavailable. - Race SpawnChoice: - - You can now also use left and right arrow keys to cycle through spawnpoints. - - You can now use right mouse button (mouse2) to teleport to the spawnpoint closest to Checkpoint #1. - - Your selected spawnpoint is now automatically saved to your computer for each map, so it will remember your preference next time you play the map. - Race Voting: - - Fixed an error when a map with a folder name containing an apostrophe is nominated to be displayed in the poll. It didn't matter if the map name itself contained one and this would never happen on 123robot's main server because we only put letters, numbers, and `-` in folder names unlike on our personal servers where folder names can be anything that Windows/MTA accepts, for example one of the folder names I (SpeedyFolf) have is `race-race-iyonuk'seviltimetrialiii`. - - Guard mapmanager access. Add safety checks for mapmanager (avoid errors when mapmanager isn't running e.g. when the server is being shut down) in racevoting server code. Tighten concatenation/spacing issues and ensure onResourceStart only calls setMapLastTimePlayed when mapmanager is running. - Twitch Emotes: - - Added 4 new emotes - xdx, monkaS, LangBuddha, & TrooperSoze.

In RaceMode.playerUnfreeze, verify the player vehicle exists (isElement) before calling fixVehicle and performing vehicle state changes. GENERAL UPDATES: - Added a Global Leaderboards resource: - - - This shows various stats: - - - - - - Stats for each player: - - - - - - - - - The number of top 1, top 2, and top 3 times they have. - - - - - - - - - The number of places they have on the F5 leaderboard. - - - - - - - - - How many maps they have not set a time on. - - - - - - - - - The total sum of all of their places (lower = better) and total sum of all of their times. - - - - - - - - - - - - If a player is not ranked on a map, their time for that map will be registered as whatever the timelimit for that map is, and their rank will be the number of players ranked for that map, plus one. - - - - - - - - - - - - Players are ranked based on the total sum of their times. - - - - - - The community sum of best is also shown. - - - - - - Double click on a player name to add a new tab, that shows all of their ranks and times for each map, plus a delta between their time and the top time. - - - - - - - - - A tab for your own self is helpfully added automatically. - - - - - - Double click on a map name to view the full leaderboards (not just top 11) for that map. - - - - - - A full map list with stats is also provided. - GENERAL UPDATES: - Basic support for on-foot races. See below for more information. - Nick protection now ignores hex colour codes, meaning your name is now protected regardless of what colour it is in. Hopefully this aids in stopping the recent influx of impersonators.. - Definitely for sure for real definitely maybe fixed issues with race information UI pertaining to boolean values being set to nil, false, or true. Hopefully it now displays correct information. - SASS now no longer breaks when ghost mode is not defined for a map. - Several behind the scenes changes in how resources like SASS, DevMode & Toptimes are run as well as some folder reorganizing. - Help window (F9) now no longer shows an empty line at the top on certain help texts where it appeared.
FOOTRACES: - It's finally here: On foot racing! Rather than making a large update to provide all the desired functionality at once, we're instead releasing BETA updates to foot races as they come. This is the first update. - Footracing will only be enabled on selected maps, by means of a new setting 'allowonfoot', which must be set to true. - Maps with this setting enabled will allow you to exit your vehicle by pressing the enter/exit key. - Because this key also handles suiciding, in order to kill yourself on these maps, the button is to be held down for 1 whole second. - If you wish to have a key for immediate suiciding, bind a key to 'kill immediately'. - Suicide remains immediate on non-foot races. - Further functionality will be added in the future. Right now we focused on providing the most barebones functionality possible. - Some sample maps have been added to demo the new gamemode. These are tagged with the [F] tag. - If you wish to make your own maps, keep in mind that future updates might break backwards compatibility while this is still in BETA, so be prepared to update your maps in the future when needed. - For now only races that start in a vehicle and end on foot are supported. - We hope you enjoy :)
MAP CREATORS: - An EDF has been added to race_ghost resource. This will allow you to reveal the disableraceghosts setting in the map editor settings menu. - Added EDF resource edf_123robot, which can be used to set the racetype of a created map (by means of adding it as a setting, not as a tag). - Made some minor adjustments to the mapEditorScriptingExtension that is automatically generated when saving a map using our in-house editor. Be sure to update the editor if you're using it.

Added it now. - Updated the mapEditorScriptingExtension_s.lua template to be more accurate and more exhaustive, and throw a more descriptive error message should one occur. - Added missing ped skins 48 (Hippy Maley), 98 (Worker Male), & 239 (Homeless Bob) to the map editor. - Added missing vehicles 505 (Rancher Lure), 594 (RC Cam), 604 (Glendale Damaged), & 605 (Sadler Damaged) to the map editor.
COLLECTIBLES: - Added new coloured hidden packages to Mulholland. - Added 3 new black hidden packages to "Stunt City" that require more stunting and OoB searching compared to the map's preexisting packages. - Added 1 more black hidden package to a huge out of bounds area that was overlooked earlier in "4x4DirtRide", accessible from the final checkpoint. - Packages can no longer be collected through floors or walls. Because of this: - - - A red package in Hankypanky Point's collection status has been reset. - - - A yellow package in The Emerald Isle has been moved back to its original spot, and its collection status has been reset. - - - A red package in Restricted Area has been moved back to its original spot. Its collection status has not been reset. - A large code rewrite should reduce lag spikes caused by the hidden packages resource. - Collecting a package will now show up in the kill feed. - Fully completed regions will be coloured more significantly differently from regions that are missing only one package. - Packages are now placed over the course of a few seconds when joining, decreasing loading times when joining the server and reducing lag spikes when performing several actions such as resetting packages or logging into a different account. - The big UI now no longer seems to cause a large lag spike when generated in one go, so it now generates in one go. - The big UI now places tickmarks under each package bar, allowing for easier distinguishing between packages. - The big UI now is centered on the screen. - The big UI no longer overlaps the labels and the package bars on certain resolutions. - The label for package #720 now no longer shows up as it was placed outside the UI's boundaries. - The package collection notification now shows up on top of the small UI overlay. - The small overlay now looks the same on every aspect ratio, and should now no longer overlap its left and right texts when many orange packages have been collected. - Several other minor scaling and positioning differences to the various UI elements. - Blue package related UI elements now show up as azure rather than deep blue, aiding legibility. - A minor chat message rephrasing for the message that appears when all packages of a type in a region have been collected. - Hidden package collection is now stored in SQL format rather than JSON. This has several benefits: - - - Package collection is now saved instantly, no longer requiring the user to disconnect to save progress, and no longer undoing collection progress when the server shuts down or the resource is stopped while a player is still connected. - - - One can now specify which packages to reset using the /resetPackages command in case they want to, for example, only recollect packages in a certain region. For more information, see the F9 help window. - - - In addition to vehicle used, it now also saves a timestamp of collection as well as what map and checkpoint the collector was on. - - - When packages are reset, it will now flag them in the database rather than deleting the entries entirely, allowing server administrators and resource maintainers to manually undo incorrectly reset packages. - - - Several other behind the scenes things. - The player's current region is now detected using a lookup table, rather than using a tonne of colshapes. This should no longer hinder developers' vision when they are using /showcol. - Guests can now disable hidden packages with /togglepackages, no longer requiring an account login. - Package collection is now handled client side, reducing delays and inaccuracies when collecting a package. - Blips will now show up when collecting a package after turning on blips while no packages have been collected.

~~~20/11/2024 Update~~~ You know, I was expecting this update to be relatively benign and not have very much substantial in it. Then I do a review and find 15 merge requests, many of which are completely overhauling major features, and then have a cry.
So this update, as you'll mostly tell from the General Updates section, changes many major resources on the server. The stuff that you might not always notice but greatly enhance the experience, like race ghosts, hiding players, top times, race info UI, new PB messages, and stunt bonus rewards. The CORPORATE IDENTITY of the server as you know it has transformed, sort of, or it'll feel like it anyway since so much looks different. Or you might not even notice cause there's so much of it is code, but trust me, it's big. You'll find all the information below - some of it is entirely new resources replacing old ones, some just extensive changes to existing ones. All of which will improve the server...if they all work. Because of the severity of the changes, I've spent some time trying to make sure they all work as expected, but with how much there is, there is a high chance of something unexpected occurring. So we will all be remaining vigilant that everything is working as intended, but please bear with us if there are some teething problems we have to deal with. We'll do our best to smooth things out, and hopefully in the end, it will be an overall net positive.
So yeah, this update mostly concerns the aspects of the server surrounding the races, which will improve your experience of anything across the board, but there's not too many map specific things. But please enjoy the 5 new maps that have been added, and of course, the hidden packages. A lot of people have worked very hard on this update, and I do genuinely appreciate how much is being done for it even if it is difficult to put it all together, so I really hope you all enjoy it!

GENERAL UPDATES: - Race Ghost: - - - Old ghosts will be loaded with a much, MUCH faster method (loading all at once, then going through it using :gsub) and then overwritten with the new JSON format. - - - New ghosts will be stored directly to JSON. - - - Load times are improved by what I can only describe as "infinitely". A 50 MB ghost file in JSON format takes about 2.5 seconds to load, while with the old XML parser it... just fails after about 2 minutes. - - - It will now store them in the priv folder for the corresponding server ("<Multi Theft Auto Installation Directory>\mods\deathmatch\priv\<Server ID>\race_ghost\ghosts\"). For reference, 123robot's server ID is "2DE7F5". - - - As for loading and converting legacy ghosts, it is going through the following procedure: - - - - - - 1. Try to load from the priv folder. - - - - - - 2. Doesn't exist? Try to load from the old folder (and save to the priv folder). - - - - - - 3. Also doesn't exist? Request from the server (and save to the priv folder). - - - Added a setting to change the maximum ghost time. The default limit is 10 minutes. - - - Assuming this works well, it is likely that maps with ghosts disabled due to length will be able to have their ghosts re-instated in the future. - Sparkling Anti Social Simulator: - - - This replacement for ASS didn't quite work as intended last time, mostly due to the fact that it cause transparency in non-ghostmode maps. This has now been fixed, so we'll give it another go! - - - There's a new UI that is now accessible by both /hide and /sass, where you can change all of the settings for the resource in one place. As well as setting the type, there are also checkboxes for the alternate ghost mode and whether or not to enable when spectating. - - - Due to the new UI command, cycling through hide modes isn't possible with just /hide anymore and instead have to be explicitly set with /hide 1 for example or using the UI - both options are available. - - - Settings are now stored on the client side in the private folder, so they're per server. - A new race addon resource (race_information_ui) has been added which handles the information in the bottom left and the travelling screen, with plans for future expansion. Additionally certain settings have been modified or added to the race gamemode to disable these within the gamemode resource itself to make room for it. The following changes may be noticed: - - - Holding the scoreboard key (by default bound to TAB (↹)) will now expand the information in the bottom left to show more detailed information alongside the scoreboard. This includes the map's description so there is no longer a need to speedread during the map transition. - - - The racetype tag ([R], [DD], etc.) is now displain again on the travelling screen and in the bottom left. - - - Slightly altered the spacing of the travelling screen's text and replaced its imagery with something smaller. - - - The colour of the bottom left text has been changed to a colour approximating Copper red (Formerly: a colour approximating Green-yellow), but 123robot has been instructed to change this to a colour of his choice using a newly added config. 123robot successfully followed his instructions and made it bright red, as is the evil robot colour. - Stunt Bonus: - - - It now logs records for different stunt types and displays a message in chat when a record is broken (eg. "New Maximum Insane Jump Flips: Discoordination, 3 flips"). - Updated the top times to some version found on the internet (sounds dodgy but don't worry about it), mostly so that it now shows the date a top time was achieved, but there are some side effects such as a darker box colour and some behind the scenes stuff. - Changed colour of PB time in the leaderboards from Cyan to Orange. - Changed colour of victory messages in the chat output from Chartreuse to Capri. - Fixed the race gamemode not accepting boolean values for boolean settings. - Added a server setting that allows disabling the current map ending when no players are on the server (useful for testing). - Fixed a typographical error in one of the repeated vote start chat messages.
COLLECTIBLES: - Added new coloured hidden packages in Palomino Creek, Richman, & Rockshore. - Made changes to the UI box scaling, hopefully resolving cases where its size was not matching its contents. - Added an experimental Big UI option to be toggled with /toggleBigUI. - Updated help (F9).
~~~13/11/2024 Update~~~ Greetings. You may notice there was not an update last week. But it would be wrong of me to not acknowledge his hard work so big thank you to him. GENERAL UPDATES: - Anti World Blow is now disabled on maps with either collisions or vehicle weapons enabled. - The Vote Manager will now present the last time a map was played. - The chat message about your personal map rating will now also show up when you join the server mid-map. - The scoreboard now shows vehicle names instead of model IDs, as well as a player's current zone. - When you do a stunt, it will now inform you about it, just like in Single Player. - Added a resource to assist with dealing with the consequences of renaming maps or files, like top times, map ratings, and ghosts no longer matching the map name. MAP CREATORS: Race Tags: - - - Race tags ([R],[DD],[MG],[SR],[TW]) are removed from map names directly and now added as an attribute like so: 'racetype="R"' placed in the same line as author, description, mapname, etc. This is to make the maps more compatible with other servers. - - - As a form of redundancy, this can also be added as a setting 'racetype' instead. - - - Filenames and internal folder structure have been changed accordingly, to speed up navigation. - - - Please see the readme on our GitLab page for more information. Checkpoint hitbox sizes: - - - Added an 'extracolshapesize' setting to checkpoints that allows you to manipulate the checkpoint's hitbox size. - - - By default this was and is set to 4, meaning each checkpoint, regardless of size, had an extra 4 meters or so added to its hitbox radius. - - - With this setting, you can now customize this number to make a checkpoint's hitbox much bigger, or smaller, than its visual appearance. - - - Accepted values will be any number. Decimals are allowed. The default is 4. Setting it to 0 makes the hitbox equal to the visible marker. Negative values are possible to make the hitbox smaller, with the lowest possible value being negative the checkpoint's visible size. - - - Please use this SPARINGLY. There will be no visible indicators that a particular checkpoint's size is different so making unobvious changes can lead to confusion or frustration. It is recommended to continue placing barriers on the sides of checkpoints, or creating a custom visual indicator. - - - Please note that this is also not backwards compatible, so your checkpoints will have their regular hitbox sizes on other servers. - - - To test: Update your race gamemode resource to ours, and use the devmode resource to visualize the hitboxes. - - - An example map has been added: "[R] Dutch Mountain Biking", showcasing a map with decreased checkpoint hitboxes. MapEditorScriptingExtensions: - - - Updated the map editor to the most recent official release version. - - - We further updated the map editor found on this server's gitlab to use an experimental version of the mapEditorScriptingExtension resource, which it adds to each map by default. These files deal with various things outside the map editor. Most notably: Draw distance. - - - In addition to updating the file to an experimental version on the official MTA resources github, various custom changes have been applied that deal with scaled or transparent objects. A change has also been made to decrease their filesize when generated by the editor, so we request you to use our editor :P - - - But if you are using your own map editor, and your map includes large, breakable, rescaled, transparent, or removed world objects, please take the newly added mapEditorScriptingExtension_s file in the [Templates] folder and replace yours with it. - - - More info will be found in the readme on GitLab soon.

~~~01/05/2024 Update~~~ Robot is still away, so it's me again. While I am in charge of this MOTD, I will go ahead and experiment a little with the order and format of the detailed update log, see what makes the most sense. This update includes some new maps, some minor updates, and an update that might be useful to some of you that create more exotic maps. Some of the new maps/map updates came in just before the previous update went out so I wasn't able to get them done in time; I thank you for your patience! -LotsOfS

GENERAL UPDATES: - Car colours broke entirely in the previous update. This should now be resolved. - Fixed an issue where typing /hide 0 after using /hide 2 would not correctly restore every player's visibility. - The race progress bar & race minimap now use the same algorithm for determining checkpoint order as the race gamemode itself, fixing issues where these would just not show up accurately whatsoever for races that had checkpoints out of order in their map file. - Fix a grammar error in the chat warning for maps with too few spawnpoints. - Added some debug prints to Race Ghost to help figure out why it breaks for some people. - Allow for custom checkpoint radar blip size.
VOTING UPDATES: - Admins and allowed users can now use a GUI to trigger a custom vote using the /poll command. - The completion bars for poll options now match the required completion percentage and will no longer go off-screen. - There is now a spacing between the poll entry index numbers and the entry names. - The voting window will now shrink again after being enlarged for long entries earlier. - Some major code cleanup was done internally so we can make something better soon. - We will continue to track data on how often a map gets nominated to (dis)prove that the RNG as it is currently is biased.
MAP CREATORS: - You can now change the blip size of your checkpoints by adding a "blipsize" attribute to the checkpoint's node in the .map file, and setting its value to an integer. - This is recommended for maps where the checkpoints are far away and bigger blips are desired so it's easier to find on the F11 map. For example: "[R] Find Your Way". - Alternatively this is useful for checkpoints that are activated by script instead of hit normally. For example "[R] Pack Mule" has 100 checkpoints used to maintain some sense of logic in the progress bar and player ranking, which manifested themselves in the form of a black up-pointing triangle in the middle of the Los Santos bay. - Setting the blipsize to 0 will make it completely invisible. For reference: The default checkpoint blipsize is 2. The size of player blips and the upcoming checkpoint blip is 1. The size of the chased checkpoint blip in "[R] Pack Mule" is 4. - Keep in mind that this is a change that applies to this server only. Until we work out a way to get this feature approved into the official race gamemode, it is recommended that you continue to keep your scripty checkpoints tidy so your maps will also show up well in other and older versions of the race gamemode.
HIDDEN PACKAGES: - Added black hidden packages to remaining eligible [R] maps that were added to the server before 14/03/2024 - Chat output now colours the package type again. - Red packages weren't counted for the total count of a specific region. ~~~17/04/2024 Update~~~ At this point, I don't think I even have words to describe the size these updates are getting. To be fair though, there's been a lot of work from the combined efforts of me, S, and Ali_Digitali behind the scenes to smooth out the player experience as much as possible, and the amount of changes is a signifier of how much work we've done to achieve that. So I'm very proud of everyone who is helping make the server better, including the many map creators who have contributed to this update! Strap in - this one will keep you going for a while. Which is good, because I have no idea when the next update will be after this one. So I'm pleased to be able to provide as much content as possible in this update to hopefully last for a while.
If you somehow have the patience to read through every single line of this changelog, I salute you.

SUPER FLEISCHBERG AUTOS: Hi guys, LotsOfS here: Thanks for attending my birthday party! :) Whether you are here to complete the full thing, or just hang out for a little while and only deliver a few, I hope you will all enjoy the race and have a good time. The race will last for 24 hours, or until everyone has finished. Progress is autosaved upon disconnect and will be restored after watching the intro cutscene again after reconnecting, so feel free to leave, take a break, and then come back at any time within those 24 hours. If you were wondering what has changed about the map since last time: - Fixed the BF-400 spawning incorrectly if it was the first vehicle chosen. Its spawn has been raised into the air slightly just to be doubly sure. - Fixed a critical bug where dying would sometimes randomly complete delivery of the vehicle, especially with a lot of players present - The leaderboards work again and properly separate boards by chosen quantity. - The race progress bar will now show a length of 212 decameter instead of 312, making it easier to interpet (1 car = 1dam). - Slightly adjusted the Squalo spawn so driving it out is easier without getting stuck on stuff. - Fix a bug where boats would sometimes teleport onto the hook instead of the hook being lowered towards the boat. - Overtime of the map has been set to equal its duration. This may get lowered in the future, but for now everyone gets 24 hours to finish! - The pile of rubble looks more significant and is visible from further away - It should now be slightly easier to avoid destruction of 'the big three' near the delivery point. - The secondary crane will no longer drop planes to their death in the parking lot. It will lower them gently now! - Vehicle model ID is displain in the bottom left upon spawning, as well as on the scoreboard/player menu. - The scoreboard/player menu also shows earned cash from deliveries, based on the monetary value of each vehicle and is affected by vehicle damage. This is merely a fun statistic or secondary goal and has no gameplay effect. - Cranes received a massive behind the scenes overhaul in general and should break much less often than they used to. In case one still does: You can simply reconnect to the server to fix the cranes and your progress will be restored after watching the intro cutscene again. Do not disconnect a second time before the cutscene has ended, this may cause your progress to be erased! Thanks, and have fun!

~~~21/12/2020 - The Christmas SR Update~~~ Merry Christmas, everyone! Hope you're having lovely jolly holidays and all of that. In celebration of the occasion, I've been working hard to push out a big Christmas update for you guys, and here it is! Managed to get it in before Christmas actually happened at least. Other than minor fixes, this update is just a whole load of SR maps - I remembered that this is a Speedrunner Server and decided there should be more SR-based content. :P So there's loads of that, and also another special surprise map! But yeah, this update took a lot of work from me, making sure all of the SR maps were accurate and true to their singleplayer counterparts, so don't expect another update for quite a while. NEW MAPS: - Every single street and air race from singleplayer has been ported to the server so you can compete against each other in them live! That's 23 in total. Everyone's favourite mission, now playable with your friends! - "[SR] Monster" ported by 123robot - "[SR] N.O.E." ported by 123robot - "[R] Randomizer Race 3" by 123robot, the big last surprise gift! For those who aren't so interested in the serious racing and more the wacky maps, there's another one for you!
MAP EDITS: - "[R] Just Business" now has respawns disabled to prevent an exploit that broke the scripting. Top times that used this have been removed.
REMOVED MAPS: - "[R] Love A Rainy Map". Turns out no one loved it after all. - A duplicate of "[R] Rally_Italy_SS1" that had somehow been in the map pool without anyone noticing for ages. Where players have better times on the duplicate map, they have been moved to the other one.
RESOURCES: - The F9 Help Menu now explains the race prefixes in the Vote Manager section. Now if anyone asks, tell them to press F9. Teach to fish! - Hidden Package help has been updated with the new areas containing packages. - New PBs are now displayed more generously, especially if fewer players are online.
~~~ 03/12/2020 Update~~~ Don't get too excited - this isn't really a full update, more an improvement of a specific series of map. That's right, the esteemed Tug Team RacingTM series, beloved by all. Quick summary of what's changed below:
- "[R] Tug Team Racing 2: Electric Boogaloo" has been split into two maps, as the second, more challening part of the map was considered too jarring to be combined with the rest of it. The first half of the map is now "[R] Tug Team Racing 2: Electric Boogaloo" and the challenge section of the map is now split into "[R] Tug Team Racing 2.5: Extra Stage" - "[R] Tug Team Racing 3" has been added, yet another installment in the acclaimed series. Enjoy!
While this update does not include any further changes, I can assure you that more maps, fixes, and other improvements are being worked on as we speak, so more updates are to come!
~~~ 02/12/2020 Update~~~ In recognition of some renewed interest in the server thanks to the POWER OF LIVE STREAMS, we've been working on several changes, improvements and fixes for the server, as well as new maps, some of which are still in the works and will come in future updates, however there's still a lot new to enjoy here. With many thanks to S. for his assistance with several of these changes:
NEW MAPS: - "[R] Going Up 2" by S. & Gang - "[R] U" by S. - "[R] Blazing Chandelle - Stage 3" by Ross - "[R] Tug Team Racing 2: Electric Boogaloo" by Ross - "[R] Airport Construction" by Gang - "[R] Congested Slopes" by Jonza - "[R] Stunt City" by R3D4NG3L - "[R] Highway Drift" by Destroyer-GT - "[R] Ridin' Around Angel Pine" by Samy - "[R] Shooting Through SF" by AdnanKananda - "[R] Vagos Drive" - "[R] Fatal Freeway" by KRraAaSH - "[R] Onwards and Upwards" - "[R] Precarious Pathway" - "[R] Deadline" by S. - "[R] Dinghy Race?" by S. - "[R] Going Down 2 (Ocean Docks)" by Herman-Hedning - "[R] Going Down 5 (Easter Bay)" by Herman-Hedning - "[R] SF SPRINT" by BLaCKMaMBa - "[R] Smonster" by S. - "[R] Tank Invaded Farm" by S. - "[R] Weapon Drop" (this map is now finally playable after several attempts to add it in the past) - "[SR] Low Stakes, High Bike" by Nasho
MAP EDITS: - "[R] Going Up 1" has had several changes to make the race experience easier and more natural, as well as making it look a bit nicer. - "[R] Big Loop" has been slightly modified to make the loop easier to complete properly. - "[MG] Musical Garages" has had a bug fixed that caused the number of garages not to correctly decrease with the players. - "[R] PingPong2.5" now has the ability to respawn destroyed mines. - "[R] HotringRaceTrack" has had its repsawn time reduced. - "[R] Mountain Course" now no longer allows other players to break the wooden paths you need to progress through the race. - "[R] Wu Zi Mu" and "[R] Farewell, My Love..." are now much more accurate to their singleplayer counterparts. The sizes of checkpoints have been increased to more closely match singleplayer hitboxes, everybody now spawns where you would in singleplayer, and the ZR-350 in "[R] Farewell, My Love..." uses offroad wheels as in singleplayer. - "[DD] Snake Farm" now displays a clear warning when you are losing health from not moving. - "[DD] Die Another Day" uses improved text drawing code and takes away health when far away from other players as in the Infernus Showdown maps. - "[R] Liberty City Run-around" now features collision over the entire city rather than only some parts, so it is now highly unlikely you will fall through somewhere you don't expect. It also now plays voice lines upon completion. - "[SR] Import/Export Race" now allows you to view the full experience leaderboard as well as the shortened leaderboard with F5. - "[R] Chase the Checkpoint" has less unnecessary chat output. The most heavily modified maps have had their ratings and times reset where the changes are too great for the stats of the original map to reflect its new state.
REMOVED MAPS: - "[R] Hot Package: The First 2018" for being broken and a bit rubbish. The general concept of a trucking race could be good with improvements in the future though.
RESOURCES: - More hidden packages have been added to find in Tierra Robada and northern areas of San Fierro. If you had already found the existing packages, there's now more out there to discover! - Car colours can now generate more random values, allowing for more variety and helping your car pop out more from others. - Fixed the MOTD so that it displays at a smaller size for lower resolutions. - Obtaining a top time now informs you of your time save over your PB as well. - Many improvements and changes to the voting system. Maps can now be matched by their internal name so all maps can be voted for. Voting threshold for /voteredo and /votemap have been increased so that a larger majority is required for success. /votemap [name] now sets the map being voted for as being the next map rather than instantly switching.
~~~03/07/2020 Update~~~ Been a little bit since the last update, eh? A lot of this stuff has been in the pipeline for a while, but now the update's finally coming to the server! This mostly focuses on general quality of life improvements and fixes to the server - not too much in the way of new maps. Still, hope you enjoy the additions! Huge thanks to Ali_Digitali, who is the main one to thank for a lot of these changes!
NEW MAPS: - "[DD] Snake Farm" by Ali_Digitali - "[R] Solid Poles" by Gang and S.
MAP EDITS: - "[MG] Tears of the Dragon" now saves the longest survival times to the scoreboard. - "[DD] Tower Game 1" now has a map limit so that players can no longer fly endlessly out of bounds. - "[R] Hold the Line" now has further improved checkpoint collisions. - "[DD] A Wise Man from the East" fixes the issue that caused players to occasionally fall through the floor. - "[R] Disco Drive" has decreased chances of disco cars, and added traffic lights at the beginning. - "[DD] Catapult!" has been modified to try to improve balance - catapults now have landing safety nets and they have a 200HP benefit. - "[SR] NRG-500" now has increased sizes for checkpoint hitboxes. - "[R] Hold the Line: Night Ring" is more generally stable and uses a more dynamic colour system. - "[R] Disco Dash" has more colour variation, and no more flashing buildings.
RESOURCES: - The author of the current map is now displayed in the bottom left info panel. - The /2048 minigame now has a moveable window and an additional WASD control scheme. - Your personal best time is now displayed in the scoreboard if it's not in the top 10. - Top times are now outputted to the chat.

~~~ 15/12/2013 Update ~~~ Remember to use /rate to rate good and bad maps, bad maps will be removed every now and then to keep a good standard of map pool. "/rate 7" means to give a map a 7 out of 10 rating. Press F9 for help using the server's modes and mods. If you would like your map added to the server, send Joshimuz a PM on twitch.tv A proper way of sending in maps will be made Soon(TM)
~~~ 14/12/2013 Update ~~~ The play again option in the vote-manager is now limited to 2 times, meaning a map can now only be played 3 times maximum, before playing another map. The amount of choices was also reduced to 5 maps and play again. These changes are to promote playing of other maps, instead of the 6+1 Towers-> Kappa Towers-> Disco Derby -> 6+1 Towers endless cycle that was happening.
